description: Creates a user-to-role membership on the specified project.

id.description: ID of the project role assignment.

name.description: Display name of the assigned directory contact.

role.description: Name of the assigned project role.

user_id.description: Login ID of the assigned directory contact.

contact_id.description: Login ID of the assigned directory contact. Same value as `user_id`.

is_active.description: Whether the assigned contact is active.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the membership was created.

business_phone.description: Business phone number of the assigned directory contact. Returned only with `view=extended`.

business_phone_extension.description: Business phone extension of the assigned directory contact. Returned only with `view=extended`.

email_address.description: Email address of the assigned directory contact. Returned only with `view=extended`.

mobile_phone.description: Mobile phone number of the assigned directory contact. Returned only with `view=extended`.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the membership.

role.description: Name of the project role to assign. Must match a project role defined on the company.

user_id.description: Login ID of the project directory contact receiving the role.
